citations.line: We call him Adam.
Not the Adam of the Garden. Not the mythic stem
And master. But Adam as the living emblem
Adam.
From Adam's day to now. They are the when
Adam.
But honor Adam first.
Adam.
There is only Adam, and the patient A,
The tree began with Adam. One root. One trunk.
With Adam's line. The Y chromosome held
The three sons of Adam. The first three splits
Of Adam's time, Cain was early—too early. The knife
Adam and Eve, grieving
The second of Adam's pendants.
Of Adam himself—the unsplit trunk—alive
Who stand on land that Adam never saw.
Back to the origin man Adam—is carried, unnoticed,
Of the Near East. The line of the Adam-to-Abel-to-Seth-to-the Jeremiah
Figure who stands, in the Chinese imagination, where Adam stands
Of Adam: the finger reaching out,
Its tenth day, Rosh Hashanah, is the birthday of Adam,
